title: The comment inside a removed only entry goes with it; a footer comment stays below the emptied mapping
notes: The only entry `a` of the mapping under `x` owns `# d`: it is indented more than the key `a` (docs/edit-semantics.md, Comments). `# e` is indented as `a`, not more, so it is a footer and stays. The emptied mapping is written `{}` on the key's line and the footer is not moved into the braces: it keeps its own line below. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend wrote `x: {}` and kept `# e` below; the native backend wrote both comments inside the braces.
